theme_central: A dense legislative and ethical surah: building the moral fabric of the community, from chastity to domestic modesty, centered on the Verse of Light.
sources_note: Precise division sourced up to verse 35 (grokipedia): 1-10, 11-20, 21-26, 27-33, 35. Continuation (36-64) reconstructed from known landmarks (promise of caliphate 55, rules of domestic courtesy 58-61).

branches.title: Laws on sexual morality
branches.resume: Punishment for fornication, four witnesses required, punishment for false accusation (qadhf).

children.t: Punishment for fornication and false accusation, procedure of mutual oath-swearing (li'an)

branches.title: The affair of the slander
branches.resume: False accusation brought against Aisha by hypocrites, innocence proclaimed by revelation.

children.t: The affair of the slander (hadith al-ifk), Aisha's innocence proclaimed

branches.title: Ethical protocols, forgiveness
branches.resume: Not to follow Satan's incitements, call to forgiveness rather than resentment.

children.t: Forgiveness of past faults, warning against Satan's incitements

branches.title: Modesty, privacy, dress code
branches.resume: Asking permission before entering, lowering the gaze, rules of the hijab.

children.t: Asking permission before entering a house
Lowering the gaze, guarding one's chastity, dress rules (hijab)

branches.title: The Verse of Light
branches.resume: The parable of Allah's light, compared to the darkness of a deep sea for the disbelievers.

children.t: Houses where Allah is glorified; parable of darkness for the disbelievers

branches.title: Universal glorification, obedience
branches.resume: Everything glorifies Allah; obedience to the Messenger; promise of caliphate to the pious believers.

children.t: Everything glorifies Allah, alternation of day and night
Obedience to Allah and the Messenger, promise of caliphate, establishing prayer and zakat

branches.title: Domestic courtesy, closing
branches.resume: Asking permission at certain times, exemption for the elderly, closing on Allah's omniscience.

children.t: Rules of domestic courtesy, exemption for the elderly and disabled
True believers ask permission; Allah knows all that is in the heavens and the earth
